description: Who is sending traces in the last 24 hours: each service with its SDK and version, frontend or backend, last span, span count, average sample rate and environments; how many of the app's traces reached a backend (joined traces: zero means the app is not sending traceparent to the API, or the backend is not traced); what ingest refused per day this week (invalid, rate limited, over the daily quota). The first tool to call when performance data looks missing.
name: get_tracing_health
title: Is tracing working?
